notes: Bank holding company 10-K for 2008. Headings as printed: Item 1A is 'ITEM 1A.' alone on line 248 with its title on the next line, Item 1B is 'ITEM 1(b).' and Item 7A is 'ITEM 7-A.'. Uncertain: the Item 9B heading and the form's instruction sentence are printed twice (lines 1772 and 1774), and only the second copy is followed by 'None to report.'. Item 9B is labeled at the first copy, because lines 1772 and 1773 hold nothing but 9B's heading and instruction and so belong to 9B, not 9A; the alternative is line 1774. The one-sentence note under PART III (line 1778) stays in Item 9B. The filing ends at SIGNATURES (line 1859); the power of attorney and the exhibit index follow. Incorporated (unscored): Items 1B, 4, 9, 9B, 11 and 12. Both labelers agreed on every label, including the uncertain one.
